purpose: Controlled text submission isolates ASR/VAD from real automatic teaching; Gemini replies with real audio. No policy/provider result injection.
inputs: We need a database for a small analytics product and our engineering team is only three people.
Our budget is limited and we cannot spend much time maintaining servers.
I want to make a short comparison of the two choices: lower monthly bills on one side, less maintenance work and fewer outages on the other.
I'm still deciding which downside our team could accept.
optional_fifth: One trade-off is that a managed database costs more but gives our small team more time to build features.
stop_condition: After four replies, if no cross-turn policy binding, stop without changing inputs. If bound, wait for effect assessment and submit optional fifth once to verify exact quote anchoring. Then snapshot and stop.
limits: Fifth sentence is prewritten synthetic learner input, not learning or causal effectiveness evidence. Usage/Example already covered by run-04.
